class.name: OcgGceMakecirc2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for `gp_Circ2d`. Supported constructions include: - circle from axis and radius; - circle concentric to another one, through point or at signed offset; - circle through three points; - circle from center and radius; - circle from center and one point.

method.name: from_gp_Ax22d_const_ref_double
method.description: Creates a circle from local coordinate system and radius.

method.name: from_gp_Circ2d_const_ref_double
method.description: Creates a circle concentric to input circle with signed offset.

method.name: from_gp_Circ2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref
method.description: Creates a circle concentric to input circle and passing through a point.

method.name: from_gp_Ax2d_const_ref_double_bool
method.description: Creates a circle from axis and radius.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref
method.description: Creates a circle passing through three points.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_double_bool
method.description: Creates a circle from center and radius.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_bool
method.description: Creates a circle from center and one point on circle.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed circle. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if no circle is constructed.

method.name: Operator
method.description: Alias for Value() returning a copy.
